reason: I refuse to risk client confidentiality and records, and leaving files in Google Drive makes me worry an assistant could accidentally delete or move an entire client folder. Until there is absolute protection against accidental folder deletion by staff, I cannot trust it with our sensitive ITR and PAN records.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: A tamper-proof Drive permission lock and automated recovery safeguard ensuring assistants cannot move or delete client folders.
